observations: Official re-render workflow uses source-video concat condition plus target-view depth/mask.
Old Level1 omits both concat_video and depth_cond while keeping trained LoRA; pure-image behavior is an ablation, not documented working image-only product mode.
Trainer explicit cfg_scale=1 overrides pipeline default5. New control uses native cfg_scale5 without touching model weights or sampler.
LoRA strength0 control is labelled Wan base diagnostic and must never be reported as DepthDirector repaired.
encode_warped_frames VAE-encodes RGB zero and mask0 into generally nonzero latent tensors.
Old Level1 positive branch receives encoded zero RGB/mask; negative CFG branch uses dropped zero latents. It does not remove geometric evidence symmetrically.
New native-drop controls use existing drop_out_latent branch for both CFG branches; inference is experimental until measured.
